system.description:
You are a vessel of fracture, your power born from pain and instability.

You gain a resource called Echo. Your maximum Echo capacity is equal to your Tier. At character creation you start with maximum Echo:

  • Each time you mark one or more Hit Points, gain an Echo.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v1.0 Heart

system.gmNotes: Gaining Echo when you mark Hit Points is not automated: raise this resource by hand.
